title: Bounded forge monthly production v1 closed DTOs
description: Independent three-command, shared-current forge root with a provisional month-start specialty stage after core completion. Static schema document only; no schema validator, product, test, build, compilation, typecheck or scenario was executed. All DTO objects are closed and required, arrays and nullable branches bounded, and full constant policies, catalogs and evidence retained. The owner separately rejects negative zero, unsafe descriptors/prototypes, proxies, cycles, sparse/decorated arrays, symbols and decoded duplicate JSON keys; enforces actual 8,388,608 UTF-8 bytes, 250,000 occurrence-counted nodes, depth 48, array length 4,096 and object keys 128; and fully folds history from genesis at every prefix. All identity/ordering/capacity, governor/slot, observed-input equality, capture order, arithmetic, write-chain, month uniqueness, calendar, digest and atomicity relationships remain owner responsibilities. Schema acceptance cannot establish reachability, first errors, native equivalence, detached frozen output or completed work. Only arithmetic.factorValue and arithmetic.scaledValue can contain noninteger half values. The new trace domain is 128; the complete nested BasePolicy retains its independent old 512 identity. No payroll or full finance integration is claimed.
$comment: Public contract: docs/engine/bounded-forge-monthly-production.md. All 84 exported DTO aliases map to complete $defs: BoundedForgeMonthlyProduction{ContractName}V1, except DateV1 maps to BoundedForgeMonthlyProductionDateV1. Top-level oneOf lists distinct complete root shapes; standalone leaf aliases use their $defs references. BasePolicy is an embedded provenance contract, not a second root entry. Cross-field derivations and safe JSON/full-fold behavior are enforced by the owner, not by this schema.

JobId.description: Exactly job: plus the complete opening envelope ID; equality is checked by root reconstruction.

Digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 audit aid. Full policy, catalog, rate evidence, envelopes, receipts and states are still retained and compared.

ConstructionPolicy.description: The complete common registry plus exactly the first apRecovery, initialWork, rewards and completionActors policies from data/catalogs/facility-construction-policies-v1.json. Historical larger limits remain source evidence; they never override this root's narrow budgets.

ConstructionCatalog.description: Complete nine-kind catalog from data/catalogs/facility-construction-catalog-v1.json, including all levels, Chinese names, income rows and combatHpWriterRecovered. This root supports only forge level 1; other catalog entries do not enable commands.

Scenario.description: Root checks full calendar/turn horizon, marker ceilings, capacities, ownership, entity ID uniqueness, stable officer membership, distinct lot positions away from city center, facility occupancy and exactly one empty lot. Ordinary pressure is an independent supplied fact. The monthly owner additionally resolves the fixed governor ID with politics 0..100 and the complete 30-slot mapping; other officers remain U8. Creation never performs monthly catch-up.

RateReceipt.description: Full result from the original construction development/rate helpers, with all six evidence groups retained. Politics/array/arithmetic equality and max-branch identity are recomputed by the root; equality chooses politics.

ConstructionWrite.description: Exact debit or saturating credit, with before + actualDelta = after. Full arithmetic and policy-role equality are recomputed by the root.

DomesticWrite.description: Original domestic writer shape, including requested and returned. It must not be substituted by ConstructionWrite; the root recomputes exact/capped deltas, returned semantics and current balances.

Job.description: At most one permanent job. Root recomputes all selected-officer ordering, rate/snapshot/fee identities, work arithmetic, due timing, completion equality and bidirectional officer/facility locks. Completed jobs are never removed or reused.

ProductionCalculation.description: Complete existing retained domestic production audit. Only the original top-level price/quantity evidence is omitted by the established retainKernel behavior. Construction rate evidence is never omitted. facilityApplied remains the existing false literal; actual factor bits are fully retained.

Envelope.description: expectedRevision remains a full safe unsigned integer, not a 0..64 shape restriction. Full same-ID envelope equality precedes stale/history/command-body checks in the root; failure IDs are never registered.

StartDetail.description: Permanent independent start-time snapshots. A historical start receipt retains its active job and developing facility even after current state completes. Root checks initial work 200, remaining = duration, complete unit-check order and actual reservation before/after identities.

TickDetail.description: Core advances the sole clock, recovers AP, progresses and completes construction before the monthly specialty adapter. All three equipment items and their entire kernel audits are retained. Any late failure discards the complete advance candidate.

State.description: Shape allows 64 history entries as contracted; reachability is established only by full ordered fold from genesis, exact receipt and complete-state equality at every prefix, and safety budgets. The AP proof bounds reachable histories to 36 without changing the 64-entry input shape.

Failure.description: All four context keys are required and explicitly nullable; private reducer failures without context remain null. Root controls finite stage/reason/context selection and first-error order; no free error text.

SerializedSave.description: Complete canonical SaveEnvelope text, not an ID or digest. maxLength is a conservative character bound from the raw UTF-8 envelope proof of 2,240,280 bytes. The owner independently enforces canonical safe JSON, exact reconstruction, raw UTF-8 and the escaped SaveResult budget; the proved escaped envelope is at most 4,480,587 bytes. contentSchema is annotation only and does not claim JSON Schema parses or validates serialized text.

Trace.description: Includes complete expected outcomes and expected final state when non-null. Expected values are compared in full and never drive transitions. Attempts may fail or duplicate without entering accepted history. Trace and ReplayResult are separately budgeted API packets.

ReplayFailure.description: Replay never returns a partial state on failure. Aggregate budget and final-state comparison failures have index null; per-attempt comparison uses its exact index.

MonthlyPolicy.description: Complete fixed simulation policy; order [1,2,3] controls this owner. specialty.order [1,2,3,4] preserves the source policy only. All completion-before-monthly, governor, slot and credit rules are provisional.

Policy.description: Full new policy identity is compared, including the entire old base with traceAttempts 512. Only outer traceAttempts 128 controls this new owner. Receipt policyDigest hashes this full object; Job.startSnapshot.policyDigest hashes its complete base.

MonthlyIdSlots.description: Thirty explicit ordered slots, at most two non-null IDs. The owner derives current facility IDs from the fixed lot mapping after core completion and verifies each identity; null is an explicit empty slot.

MonthlyLotSlots.description: Every supplied lot, including the single initial empty lot, appears exactly once. The owner checks membership, non-null uniqueness and coverage; repeated null slots are required and do not use uniqueItems.

MonthlyFacts.description: Selected governor must be a supplied same-city/same-force officer with politics 0..100. Other officers retain U8 politics. The owner checks the selected ID and all 30 slots after complete policy validation; availability, acted and reservation do not gate monthly production.

MonthlySlots.description: Exactly thirty observations; validity 0 has no completed field, validity 1 requires completed 0 or 1. At most two current facilities. The owner preserves developing validity=1/completed=0, exact lot order and source/current identities.

MonthlyInput.description: Mutually exclusive exact 4-, 5- or 6-key inputs. A non-specialty input has no slots/politics; a zero-completion specialty input omits politics; a production input requires politics. Owner derives all observations from current state, binds equipment and verifies result.observations equals the entire input.

MonthlyCapture.description: Each capture has exactly seven fields and the source address/target/width literals. The owner binds eaxU32=consumedValue, exact slot indices, every validity/completed adjacency, and final governor position to the derived input.

MonthlyNoCompletedCaptures.description: Specialty then thirty validity captures and up to two incomplete-facility captures. No governor call. Owner enforces slot order, matching completed captures and observed bit equality.

MonthlyProductionCaptures.description: Specialty, thirty validity calls, one or two existing-facility completed calls, and one governor call. The owner enforces exact order and all bit/slot/politics correspondence; developing facilities also produce a completed-helper capture.

MonthlyArithmetic.description: The owner checks politicsTerm=floor(politicsAL/2)+60, scaledValue=politicsTerm*factorValue*3, truncation toward zero and all source bit identities. The two allowed noninteger positions are factorValue=1.5 and exact half-integral scaledValue; all requests, captures and writes are integers. The 1500 kernel cap is unreachable in this root, so capApplied is false.

MonthlyQuantityRequest.description: Both quantity fields equal the complete arithmetic convertedSigned32; the owner verifies these equalities and the item kernelQuantityRequest.

MonthlyEvidence.description: Complete original monthly-kernel evidence: eight fixed strings and fourteen false flags. The outer simulation stock writer does not change any native integration or execution claim.

MonthlyKernelResult.description: Three closed result paths, with production count coupled to factor/bit tier and exact completed-slot count. Full observations, captures, arithmetic, request and all evidence fields are retained. Owner binds equipment, input equality, capture order and every arithmetic equality.

MonthlyKernelCall.description: The full original input and full result.observations are both retained, independently counted in budgets and compared by the owner. Neither is omitted or replaced by a digest.

MonthlyWrite.description: Owner verifies before is the same current.ledger.inventory[k].quantity used by ordinary Produce; cap equals genesis capacity; requested equals the kernel request; accepted=actualDelta=min(requested,cap-before); after=before+accepted; discarded=requested-accepted. Full inventory still records the complete request/write with accepted zero.

MonthlyItem.description: Five mutually exclusive seven-key eligibility branches; called branches point to the matching kernel result path, never a generic unrelated result. Production count is tied to the corresponding result count and factor tier; nonproduction request/write fields remain explicit null.

MonthlyReceipt.description: Three mutually exclusive exact five-key status shapes. The items tuple always contains equipment 1, 2, 3 in that order. Non-month-start has all three facts null and three not-due items; month-start without governor has settlement/current facilities and three no-governor items; settled has the fixed current governor and only called item paths. Owner binds status to new clock date, settlement to city/year/month, facilities to post-completion current, all observations to these facts, ordered stock writes, and uniqueness of each historical settlement. Settled does not mean payroll or full finance was processed.
